Advocate Alleges PGIMER Heritage Furniture Auctioned in US

An advocate has claimed that heritage furniture belonging to the Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) has been listed for auction in the United States. The advocate is seeking government intervention to halt the auction and secure the return of the items. The specific details of the furniture and the auction house were not provided in the coverage.
